messages:
Anna (Partnerships): Quick heads-up — QBR prep timeline: need final partner scorecards + MDF sweep by EOD Friday. I'm merging marketplace, HW, and SI inputs into one sheet. Link: https://rbwd.co/scorecards-draft
Sophia - Sales Ops: Got it. Which columns are final vs. draft? I still have pending deal counts from APAC partners.
Anna (Partnerships): Final columns = tier, enrolled since, quarterly ARR influenced, co-marketing requested ($), MDF requested ($), activation milestones. Everything else mark DRAFT.
Mike G: I can present the tier changes in the QBR if we lock the thresholds today. FYI we flagged 2 partners for tier bump criteria failing QA.
Anna (Partnerships): Thanks Mike. Can you add a 1-slide RCA for those two? Keep it 3 bullets each.
Jamal (Finance): Important: MDF pool is flat for the quarter. We can reallocate between tiers but total can't exceed $500k without exec sign-off. Need line-item breakdown by partner and expected FY impact.
Katie / Marketing: We have a leftover co-marketing credit of $60k that can offset MDF if we attach a campaign brief and UTM plan. Can Ops confirm eligible partners? :innocent:
Sophia - Sales Ops: APAC deal counts incoming by noon. Also need to confirm marketplace listing promo windows — that affects activation milestone dates.
Oliver - Eng: Heads-up: marketplace SKUs need a small config change before the joint announcement. ETA for fix is tomorrow morning, will update changelog.
Anna (Partnerships): Good. SOP for this QBR: 1) consolidate scorecards, 2) finance approves line-items, 3) marketing signs briefs, 4) eng confirms marketplace readiness. I'll assemble the QBR runbook after finance OKs.
mdf-bot: Reminder: MDF request cut-off in 72 hours. Submit via https://rbwd.co/mdf-requests or your request will be processed next cycle.
Jamal (Finance): To speed approvals — please attach expected KPI lift (leads or ARR) per partner. We only approve if ROAS estimate > 3x or strategic priority flagged.
Katie / Marketing: Can someone paste the promo calendar here? I want to see overlap with partner press schedules.
Sophia - Sales Ops: Promo calendar: Q2 weeks 12–14 heavy, week 13 joint announcements preferred. If eng fix slips, move to week 14.
Mike G: For scorecards: propose thresholds: Tier 1 >= $250k influenced ARR, Tier 2 >= $75k, Tier 3 >= $15k. Any objections?
Jamal (Finance): Those thresholds look reasonable given current run-rate but run a sensitivity table for headcount-adjusted ARR assumptions.
Anna (Partnerships): Action items: @Sophia gather APAC counts + paste calendar (due noon). @Mike finalize tier slide (due today 6pm). @Katie draft 2 campaign briefs for top 3 partners (due Thu). @Jamal provide confirmation or limit for reallocation (by EOD Thu). I'll lock the sheet on Friday morning and circulate runbook.
Mike G: Acknowledged.
Sophia - Sales Ops: On it.
Katie / Marketing: Will start briefs, looping in partner AMs.
Oliver - Eng: Will post changelog when the marketplace fix is deployed (tomorrow AM).
Anna (Partnerships): Thanks team — let's avoid last-minute scope creep. Ping me if you hit blockers. :thumbsup:
